item.title: ICE official admits errors in court filing for Jamaica native detained in Hauppauge
item.description: The ICE official admitted in court papers that he provided incorrrect information about a man held in a holding cell in Suffolk.

item.title: Stirtz scores career-high 32, Iowa beats Oregon 84-66 to extends Ducks' skid to 8 games
item.description: Bennett Stirtz scored a career-high 32 points on 12-of-15 shooting and had seven assists to help Iowa beat short-handed Oregon 84-66 for its fourth win in a row.

item.title: Lightning's historic four-goal comeback stuns Bruins in NHL Stadium Series
item.description: Nikita Kucherov scored the tying goal in the third period, Jake Guentzel scored the only goal in the shootout, and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied from a four-goal deficit to beat the Boston Bruins 6-5 in front of 64,617 fans at an NHL Stadium Series game.

item.title: Leonard scores 25 points, Clippers resume winning ways with 117-93 rout of Suns
item.description: Kawhi Leonard scored 25 points and the Los Angeles Clippers, playing without James Harden, routed the Phoenix Suns 117-93 on Sunday night.

item.title: Preliminary, partial results put Costa Rican president's handpicked successor ahead
item.description: Preliminary and partial results put the Costa Rican president's handpicked successor well ahead in a crowded field after Sunday's election.

item.title: US futures and Asian shares slip as worries over Trump's Fed chief pick and AI weigh on markets
item.description: U.S. futures and Asian shares have skidded as worries over President Donald Trump's nominee to be the next Federal Reserve chair amplified jitters over a possible bubble in the artificial intelligence boom.

item.title: LeBron James wasn't thinking about his All-Star streak after being injured to start the season
item.description: LeBron James being an All-Star was almost a certainty for two decades.

item.title: Jarrett Allen scores career-high 40 points as the Cavaliers beat the Trail Blazers 130-111
item.description: Jarrett Allen scored a career-high 40 points and grabbed 17 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers beat Portland 130-111 to hand the Trail Blazers their fifth straight loss.

item.title: Wembanyama fuels early surge in late start as Spurs overcome travel woes to beat Magic
item.description: Victor Wembanyama had 25 points, eight rebounds and five blocks and San Antonio beat the Orlando Magic 112-103 on Sunday night in a game that started five hours late because of the Spurs' travel woes.
